blocks.text: 🪝 NCDEX Launches 'NCDEX Nidhi' Mutual Fund Transaction Platform. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: National Commodity and Derivatives Exchange Ltd (NCDEX) launched **'NCDEX Nidhi'**, an API-first mutual fund transaction platform for rural FPO integration.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.

items: NCDEX Nidhi mutual fund platform enables rural retail investors to purchase units via commodity exchange trading terminals.
